choice.basis: The B-check for r1 is refuted because the dual-axis chart lacks numerical scales, and the 2018/2019 data (where the red U.S. series has higher values but is plotted lower than the blue Rest of the world series) proves the vertical positions are not directly comparable across the two axes. Without a common scale or 2020 data labels, the dashboard does not provide sufficient evidence to determine which region has the larger 2020 value.
